_numbering_note: catalog_number pending the base/hybrid renumbering (see gdd-culture-emergence-and-territory.md); csv_id is the authoritative key for now.
sub_palette: classical (latinate) lean + north_american (plains) substrate (cross-family fusion, Roman-leaning)
homeland: Nova Roma (the New Rome of the open plain; the road and the great-plains banner, the eagle over the grass-sea)

blend.lean: classical (latinate: the legion and the road, the gens and the law-stone, the urbs and the colonia, vowel-rich a/e/i/o/u with c=k, -us/-a/-um/-ius endings, penultimate stress - the rule/kin/law/land register dominant)
blend.substrate: north_american (plains: the horse-nomad bands, the warrior-societies, the buffalo-range and the medicine-bluff of the open sky, glottalized/ejective consonants, descriptive compounds - the plain/beast/mountain/material/staple register beneath)
blend.fusion: Roman-leaning - a New Rome risen on the great plains, the legion and the horse-nomad made one people: the eagle standard planted beside the great-plains banner, the paved road running out to the open sky, the urbs of stone enthroned over the buffalo-range. The Latinate backbone supplies rule, kin, law, and land-tenure; the Plains substrate supplies the plain, the beast, the mountain, and the worked material - all run through one Latin-shaped sound-law.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_06 (Roman/Latinate, civ) x BASE_11 (Plains horse-nomad/Amerindian, clan). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Roman base = Civilized, Plains base = Clanhold, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Novarom is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a New Rome on the plains - the legion and the horse-nomad, the road and the open sky, the eagle standard over the great-plains banner. The stone urbs and the paved via married to the buffalo-hunting riders of the grass-sea (a Roman-Plains fusion). LEAN = classical (latinate: the ruling/legal/civic register, the urbs and colonia, the gens and the law-stone, the Latin phonology that all words obey - penultimate stress, vowel-rich, c=k, -us/-a/-um endings); SUBSTRATE = Plains (the grassland, the herds, the mountain, the worked hide and bone and metal, the horse, the warrior-societies). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Latin and Plains registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Latinate canon-morphs PRIMARY via agrippan, Plains morphs SECONDARY via family_north_american theonym_sets.plains / numinan), never real gods. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are ENGLISH, except the empire tier which uses the approved foreign term 'Imperator' (set in 'ruler'); the *_native conlang forms live in ruler_native/domain_native (Latinate) for NPC dialogue. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Deities via the per-family morph method.

phonology.palette: Latinate lean - vowel-rich a/e/i/o/u, liquids l/r, sibilant s, stops p t c(=k) b d g, f/v, m n; -us/-a/-um/-ius/-or endings; penultimate stress; moderate onset clusters (st tr pr cl sp) - over a Plains substrate: the Plains ejectives and the barred-u and the long descriptive compounds, all bent to the Latin inventory. Per the CSV: harsh texture (the Plains ejective/glottal grain) carried on a balanced Latin rhythm; grammar is SOV and polysynthetic (the Plains compounding habit carried on Latin case-inflection). Theophoric on the Latinate canon-morphs (Tulrian-, Orlandus-, Numenius-) with Plains medicine-name variants (Torawi-, Kayanta-) as a vision-sign.
phonology.phonotactics: CV / CVC; vowel-final preferred; Latin clusters (st tr pr cl sp) and geminates (ll ss tt); Plains glottal-stops collapsed or dropped; Plains ejectives (p'/t'/k') resolved to the plain Latin stops (p t c); long Plains compounds reshaped to a Latin two-element compound; penultimate stress; -um/-ia/-a civic suffixes over Plains feature-roots.

sound_changes: Plains ejectives/glottalized stops -> Latin inventory: p'>p, t'>t, k'>c(=k), glottal-stop ' dropped (word-internal) or smoothed to a vowel
Plains barred-u and free vowels -> Latin a/e/i/o/u; long descriptive/polysynthetic compounds compressed to a Latin two-element compound
Latin word-shape imposed on every root: penultimate stress, open CV(C) syllables, a final Latin -us/-a/-um/-is on bare roots (toya>toyus mountain, soni>sonia grass-plain, puuku>pucus horse)

retain the Latin vowel-richness and clusters and one audible Plains signature (the doubled stop, the -bi/-pi echo softened to -bus/-pus) so both ancestries stay heard; SOV polysynthetic-inflecting grammar throughout
fusion_rules.source_tilt: plain/beast/mountain/material/staple words from Plains roots (the substrate works the grass and the herds and the high country: soni>sonia grass-plain, toya>toyus mountain, puuku>pucus horse, kutsu>cutsus bison, sarii>sarrium hide, tunapu>tunapum drymeat, puhihwi>pihivum metal); rule/kin/law/land-tenure/abstract words from Latin roots (the ruling register: magnus, gens, filius, urbs, sacer, via); every chosen root then filtered to one Latin-shaped sound-law

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Plains plain/beast/mountain/material/staple-roots + Latin rule/kin/law/land-roots, all run through one Latin-shaped sound-law (penultimate stress, open CV(C), -us/-a/-um, c=k, Plains ejectives collapsed to plain stops); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions, bloodline, and the horse-legion where the legion and the open plain visibly married.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Latin ruling stock carry an inherited gens (clan) name as the middle element (Marcus Toyanius); the Plains substrate keep the band/division name (e.g. Cuahada, Penateca, Latinized) and an earned deed- or vision-name; the throne fuses both - a praenomen + gens who also carries a band-name and a vision-byname.
morphology.compounding_rule: Latin [adjective|resource](stem) + feature-word, eliding before a vowel (ater + sonia -> Atrasonia, black-plain) layered over Plains descriptive [quality|animal] + feature compounds bent to Latin shape (Ecatoyus, red-mountain; Cutsusonia, bison-plain): the capital Nova Roma, the colony Colonia Toyana (the mountain-colony).

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Latinate legionary aristocracy fused with the Plains horse-nomad bands: the Imperator and his princeps-kin at the crown, the comes-governors over the urbs-cities, the castellanus-lords sworn to the legion and the war-society; the paraibo-headmen and the akicita warrior-societies of the riding bands serve within the realm, the medicine-seers and the civic scribes beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Latinate ladder, ascending (the Agrippan civic ladder), with the Plains substrate co-titles beneath. Castellanus/Castellania barony; Limitanus/Limitania (the frontier limes) march; Comes/Comitatus county; Dux/Ducatus duchy; Princeps/Principatus principality; Rex/Regnum kingdom; Imperator over the Imperium (empire). The riding bands keep their Plains chiefs within the realm: the paraibo (band peace-chief) and the tecuniwap (war chief) lead the akicita warrior-societies beneath the Latin crown; the medicine-seer (puhacatus) and the civic scribe stand outside the ladder. The empire ruler-title 'Imperator' is the approved commonly-known foreign term, shown in DISPLAY (not Englished to 'Emperor'); all other tiers display English. Rank titles fuse the real Latin and Plains registers (allowed). Per-tier family/realm size thresholds come from the ACKS domain rules (acore_axioms_strongholds_and_domains.xml); not reproduced here for IP.
title_ladder.heir: Caesar (heir-designate to the Imperator; the king's child)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH, except where an approved commonly-known foreign term is set in 'ruler' (the empire tier shows 'Imperator'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Latin ruling stock: praenomen (personal) + nomen (gens/clan, inherited) + cognomen (earned agnomen, optional); the Plains substrate: a child-name replaced at coming-of-age by an earned deed- or vision-name + the band/division; order personal-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Latin legionary aristocracy use the full tripartite gens (praenomen + nomen + cognomen); the Plains riding-folk keep a deed/vision-name + band-name; the fused houses carry both - a gens-name and a band-byname.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Latin devotional praenomina on the canon-morphs (Tulrian, Orlandus, Numenius, Realtus); Plains devotional rarely names the powers directly, more often a vision-sign (animal, sky, weather) under a morphed power (a war-vision under Maraksa).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Latinate canon-morphs PRIMARY (the agrippan keys, the reference culture other cultures rename FROM), Plains morphs SECONDARY (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.plains / numinan), never real Roman/Plains gods. Shared pantheon, two registers (Latin primary, Plains secondary). Novarom allows Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met both at the built temple-on-the-forum and at the medicine-bluff of the open sky - the law-stone and the vision-quest (puha) honored alike.
religion.the_one: Aeternus (Plains Ateruna) - the One / True God; honored in liturgy and acknowledged as the distant Great-Above, not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Tulrius (Plains Torawi) - the sun and justice, the law-stone and the open sky
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Orlandus (Plains Olanta) - iron, oath, war; the legion-eagle and the war-lance
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gaiandus (Plains Kayanta) - the enduring earth, the field and the grass-sea
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Numeno (Plains Nimawi) - air, sky-wisdom, the scribe and the seer
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Realta (Plains Reawina) - the mother, mercy, the life-giving rain

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Aeternus, Tulrius the just, Orlandus of the sworn legion, Realta the merciful - at the forum-temple and the medicine-bluff alike, and names the Chaotic powers daemones (Latin) or the dread-spirits (Plains), warded; the law-stone and the vision-quest bind together
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral dead (the deified founders and the great chiefs), the city-spirits of the urbs and the animal-spirits and the medicine (puha) of place; the great powers invoked at the forum-altar and the medicine-cairn situationally
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon (Maraxus the war-fire, Dementus the storm, Lusanto the greed-serpent) and names the Lawful powers - and Aeternus - as the tyrant-gods to be defied (the cold sky-tyrant, the chain)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as daemones (Latin) or the dread sky-/storm-spirits (Plains), keep their morphs + an epithet: Maraxus -> Maraxus the Tyrant-Flame (Plains Maraksa the War-Fire); Dementus -> Dementus the Storm-Mad (Plains Tamawi the Thunder); Lusanto -> Lusanto the Coin-Serpent (Plains Lusanta the Greed-Worm).

clergy_ladder.7: Pontifex (High Priest) / Numunu-puhacatus (the band's high seer)
clergy_ladder.9: Pontifex Maximus / Naica-puhacatus (the council's great seer)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Collegium of [power] at the forum-temple (Collegium of the Dawn Throne, Tulrius), or the medicine-bluff / vision-cairn of [power] on a high place (the Medicine-Bluff of Maraksa).
religion.saints_pattern: Divus/Diva [name] - the deified founders and legion-heroes inscribed on the law-stone, and the great chiefs and vision-seers who became sky- and animal-spirits, honored at the catacomb, the forum-stele, the burial-scaffold and the medicine-cairn.

holy_symbol_motifs.Tulrius: a rayed sun-disc above a balance and a law-stone
holy_symbol_motifs.Orlandus: the legion-eagle crossed with a war-lance over an iron oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Gaiandus: the plowed field and the grass-sea beneath the open sky

banks_patterns.ships: river-galleys and the prairie riders' war-lances and great horses: 'Aquila' (the Eagle), 'Dawn of Nova Roma', 'the Red Lance', 'Cloud-Eater' (a famed war-horse)
banks_patterns.military_units: Legio [ordinal] [cognomen] fused with the warrior-societies: 'Legio Prima Equestris (the Horse Legion)', 'the Eagle Standard', 'the Dog-Soldiers (Hotametaneo)', 'the Kit-Fox society'
banks_patterns.taverns: The [Adjective] [Noun] of the forum-town, and the council-lodge of the camp: 'The Iron Eagle', 'The Gilded Lance', 'the Great Council-Lodge'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: buried legion-colonies and old burial-scaffolds: 'the Catacombs of Divus [name]', 'the Sunken Colonia', 'the Medicine-Cairn of [chief]', 'the Ghost-Butte of [name]'

flagship_settlements: Nova Roma (the chief seat - the New Rome of the plain)
Castuyum (the great frontier-fort over the grass)
Medicine-Bluff (the Latinized Mons Puhus, the vision-altar)
